# ReFlex: Ocular Motor VR Rehab

**ReFlex** is a clinically inspired VR platform engineered to train and restore ocular motor skills through immersive, guided exercises. Designed for therapists, clinics, and neuro-rehab programs, ReFlex pairs precise real-time eye-tracking analytics with structured protocols to deliver objective, data-driven outcomes.
